title: An AI sovereign wealth fund isn't progressive – it's techno-imperialism
summary: This Financial Times opinion piece critiques the concept of an AI sovereign wealth fund, arguing that instead of being progressive, it represents a form of techno-imperialism where powerful nations or entities could control and monetize AI infrastructure at the expense of developing countries.
problem_solved: The article critiques rather than solves a problem - it raises concerns about power concentration and digital colonialism in AI governance.
why_valuable: It provides critical perspective on the geopolitical implications of AI policy proposals, warning against techno-colonialism disguised as progressive policy.
